leg_dns_desc: DNS traffic is directed to a non-standard server. Risk of Phishing or spoofing.
leg_phish_desc: Connection to TOR domains (.onion) or keywords associated with credential theft.
leg_botnet_desc: Connection detected to a known Botnet Command and Control (C2) center.
leg_botnet_trig: IP or Domain listed in Botnet / C2 databases.
leg_crypto_desc: Traffic associated with cryptocurrency mining pools (Monero, Bitcoin).
leg_crypto_trig: Ports 3333, 4444 or domains like minexmr, nanopool.
leg_exfil_desc: Possible data leak or massive transfer to a suspicious external server.
leg_exfil_trig: Anomalous outbound traffic spikes or long-lived connections.
leg_plain_desc: Unencrypted traffic detected (HTTP/FTP/Telnet). Passwords travel in clear text.
leg_nmap_desc: Active port scanning on the network to discover vulnerabilities or hosts.
leg_nmap_trig: Bursts of SYN packets to multiple ports in milliseconds.
leg_track_desc: Connection to advertising networks or massive telemetry servers.
leg_track_trig: Domain includes doubleclick, google-analytics, telemetry, etc.
leg_404_desc: The server responded with a 404 error. Could be normal or a brute force attack on directories.
